messages:
alex: starting a thread to kick off EU12 account + network origination. need cloud project, VNet scaffold, and GPU quota requests. who wants to drive?
meera: I can take project + quota requests if someone pairs on the VNet CIDR plan.
joel: I can do CIDR planning — quick question: do we want shared-services in-region or central eu-west shared? mixing has caused latency earlier.
sam: prefer in-region shared-services for infra-only traffic (metrics/ssh bastion) — reduces cross-region egress cost for control plane.
nia: +1 for in-region. proposals: use 10.52.0.0/16 for eu12-region, split as 10.52.0.0/18 shared-services, 10.52.64.0/18 cluster-pools, 10.52.128.0/17 tenant-allocated.
alex: check overlap with global reserved space. @joel can you validate 10.52 against account-level allocations? don't want to collide with customers or partner VPCs.
joel: running our allocation check now — command: `./scripts/check_cidr_overlap.sh 10.52.0.0/16` — output: no overlap with existing reserved ranges, but note 10.52.128.0/17 touches our cross-region peering block if we expand later.
meera: for cloud quotas — A100 and H100 availability varies. cc @infra-bot to create quota request ticket and attach preferred SKU list.
infra-bot: created ticket INFRA-1242 -> "eu12 GPU quota request (A100/H100)" assigned to meera. ETA for cloud approval usually 48-72h.
sam: also raising note: egress pricing in eu12 is higher on X-provider when leaving region. if customers will stage models, consider keeping cache and serving in-region.
alex: agreed. meera, include egress cost estimate in the ticket: expected steady-state 15TB/mo for initial clusters; show delta if we replicate control-plane to central region.
meera: will add cost table. quick terraform snippet we plan to use for the scaffold (will be in the repo):
```
resource "google_compute_network" "eu12_vpc" {
  name                    = "redwood-eu12-vpc"
  auto_create_subnetworks = false
}

resource "google_compute_subnetwork" "shared_services" {
  name          = "shared-services"
  ip_cidr_range = "10.52.0.0/18"
  network       = google_compute_network.eu12_vpc.self_link
  region        = "europe-north12"
}
```
nia: one more: add a /20 for GPU node pools per availability zone, 3 AZs -> 3 x /20 from cluster-pools space.
joel: noted. also we need to pre-create service account with roles: compute.networkAdmin, compute.securityAdmin, serviceusage.serviceUsageConsumer, container.admin (or equivalent). alex can you confirm exact role list for on-prem parity?
alex: role list looks good — add kms.cryptoOperator for disk encryption ops.
meera: posting checklist for handoff to support once infra ready:
- Project created and billing tied
- VPC + subnets created via terraform
- Route tables + NAT for egress
- Firewall rules for mgmt plane (bastion, metrics, ssh)
- Service account keys rotated into vault
- GPU quota approvals attached to project
- Initial node pool alpha + healthcheck smoke
- Observability endpoints (prometheus remote write, logs export)

sam: suggest also a preflight that runs these commands to validate networking after Terraform apply:
`gcloud compute networks describe redwood-eu12-vpc --project=redwood-eu12`
`gcloud compute routes list --filter="network:redwood-eu12-vpc"`
`kubectl get nodes -o wide --context eu12-alpha`

joel: I'll run the network validation and confirm CIDR allocations. planning 30-min sync tomorrow at 09:30 UTC for handoff.
alex: assigning owners: meera -> project + quota; joel -> CIDR + validation; sam -> shared-services design; nia -> subnet sizing and AZ carveouts. I'll open infra RFC and link back here.
meera: thanks. I'll attach cost estimates and quota docs to INFRA-1242.
infra-bot: INFRA-1242 updated: tags=[eu12, gpu-quota, cost-estimate], watcher=meera. ETA 2026-03-20 15:00 UTC.
sam: minor ops note — when creating NAT gateways, prefer ephemeral for initial test clusters, move to reserved ips before prod cutover to avoid churn.
alex: perfect. meeting invite sent for 09:30 UTC. please drop any preflight logs in the ticket. :thumbsup:
